test_execution: Native Node.js 22.16.0 on exact GitHub blob-hash-matched source and tests in isolated local filesystem; no hosted CI

test_cases.name: synchronous ACK completing after deadline cannot report acknowledged
synchronous idle settlement completing after deadline cannot report settled
synchronous claim completing after deadline rejects without dispatch

defect: Timer callbacks can be delayed by a synchronous operation; a fulfilled callback promise can resolve after the deadline and before the timer, falsely reporting ACK or idle settlement success.
fix: Check the deadline again in the operation fulfillment microtask; expired fulfillment rejects and requires recovery.
